about: All fork work in flight. Nodes carry the handoff: every node not done/parked has a 'next' step a cold session can pick up without chat history. WORK_LEDGER.md is the logbook of finished work.
rules: Never delete a node. Finished -> 'done'; abandoned -> 'parked' with the reason in 'next'.
Every node not 'done' or 'parked' must have a concrete 'next' step that anyone could pick up cold.
'needs' lists ids this node waits on; keep it acyclic.
Update 'status', 'next', and 'updated' in the same commit as the work, and at the end of every working session.
Run python3 .agents/check_tracking.py before committing changes here or to the ledger.

nodes.title: Identify ragesaq's printer model and confirm its wireless channel (BLE vs classic-BT SPP)
nodes.next: Done. nodes.title: Implement BleTransport behind INiimbotTransport in Niimbot.Net
nodes.next: Code COMPLETE on branch feat/ble-transport-macos (pushed, head d976041): MacBleTransport (CoreBluetooth via pure-C# ObjC interop), AsyncByteQueue, delegate bridge, NiimbotClient.FromBleDevice, print-harness scan/--ble. 52/52 tests green. HyperReview patch-review (Full tier): WARN with 3 findings (NSData autorelease leak, delegate use-after-free, callback crash-safety) — all FIXED in-loop; artifacts in .hyperreview/patch-review-2026-08-13T14-20-00Z/ on main. REMAINING: on-hardware verification on ragesaq's Mac + B1 Pro. A self-contained osx-arm64 harness binary is built at /tmp/print-harness-osx-arm64/print-harness on the codex server (rebuild with: dotnet publish tools/print-harness/print-harness.csproj -c Release -r osx-arm64 --self-contained -p:PublishSingleFile=true). Steps on the Mac: 1) copy binary over (scp keeps it unquarantined), chmod +x. 2) printer ON. 3) ./print-harness scan  -> expect 'B1 Pro-XXXXXX'. 4) ./print-harness info --ble 'B1 Pro' -> expect model id 4097, 300 dpi. 5) ./print-harness test-page --ble 'B1 Pro' (uses a label). 6) ./print-harness print --ble 'B1 Pro' --log ble-capture.log and keep the log for the PR. If macOS Bluetooth permission blocks the terminal, approve it in System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Bluetooth. Findings go here; on success flip to done + ledger, then ragesaq-005 (upstream PR incl. B1 Pro catalogue verification report).
